title: Ghosts

{{Infobox/Generic |image=File:Ghost Head.png |label1=Type |data1=[[Mechanics]] }} {{For|the [[Mob]] in the [[Dwarven Mines]]|Ghost}} '''{{grey|Ghosts}}''' are a feature in {{Zone|The Catacombs}} and {{Zone|Kuudra's Hollow}}. When a player loses all their {{Stat|hp}} in a [[Dungeons|Dungeon]], they do not die traditionally: instead, they turn into a '''{{grey|Ghost}}''' and function as a spectator with unique abilities and limited access to the {{Item|SkyBlock Menu}}. = Mechanics = ==Becoming a {{grey|Ghost}}== Players can enter a {{grey|Ghost}} state in any of the following cases: * Losing all their {{stat|hp}} in {{Zone|The Catacombs}} or in {{Zone|Kuudra's Hollow}} * Returning to the instance after leaving for any reason. ==Being a {{grey|Ghost}}== In this state: * Players are invisible to other players except for a [[File:Ghost Head.png|21px|link=]] Ghost Head that follows them; * Players {{green|can}} fly without phasing through blocks; * Players {{green|can}} teleport to a chosen alive teammate by using their {{AN|Haunt}} ability; * Players may {{orange|only}} interact with the world in {{green|2}} cases: ** in {{Zone|The Catacombs}} or {{Zone|Kuudra's Hollow}}, through the use of their respective {{grey|Ghost Abilities}} depending on their chosen [[Classes|Class]] or [[Kuudra#Perk Shop|Route]] respectively; ** in {{Zone|The Catacombs}}, killing {{MobSprite|Fairy;Fairies}} in order to revive themselves; * Players are {{red|unable}} to use the majority of the features in the {{Item|SkyBlock Menu}}; * Players are {{red|unable}} to warp out of the instance; * In {{Zone|The Catacombs}}, players may {{orange|only}} attack [[Dungeon Mobs]] in {{green|3}} cases: **with [[#Ghost Abilities|{{grey|Ghost}} Abilities]]; **with the {{Item|Spirit Sword}}, provided they had it in their inventory while alive; **with the {{Item|Spirit Shortbow}}, provided they had it in their inventory while alive; * In {{Zone|The Catacombs}}, players can view the {{Item|Magical Map}}. ==Becoming Alive== {{Stub| * Needs to be updated with Kuudra, Catacombs, using new templates are our disposal}} {{grey|Ghosts}} may be revived in the following ways: *Having a [[Revive Stone]] in their inventory prior to death. *Having a teammate use a Revive Stone. *Killing a Fairy in a Fairy Room. *Defeating the corresponding Wandering Soul in [[The Watcher]] boss fight. *By the {{AN|Revive}} passive and {{AN|Revive}} ghost ability of the Healer class. *Automatically after 15 seconds on Entrance, 45 seconds on Floor {{romnum|I}}, and 100 seconds on Floor {{romnum|II}}. *Entering a boss fight (all teammates in the dungeon are revived beforehand) = Ghost Abilities = ==In {{Zone|The Catacombs}}== {| class="wikitable" !
